findings.name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: The response does not include X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.recommendation: Consider sending X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, especially for browser-served resources.
findings.limitations: Assessment is based on one response. Reverse proxies, other routes and application-specific controls may differ.

findings.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The response does not include Content-Security-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate a CSP appropriate to the application's scripts, styles, frames and other browser resources.
findings.limitations: Assessment is based on one response. Reverse proxies, other routes and application-specific controls may differ.

findings.name: Missing X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors
findings.description: The response does not include X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.recommendation: If this page must not be embedded, configure frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options.
findings.limitations: Assessment is based on one response. Reverse proxies, other routes and application-specific controls may differ.

findings.name: Wildcard CORS origin
findings.description: The endpoint permits browser cross-origin access from any origin for responses governed by this header.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the resource is intentionally public. Otherwise, return only explicitly trusted origins.
findings.limitations: Wildcard CORS does not grant authentication or prove sensitive data exposure; endpoint data sensitivity matters.

findings.name: Technology information in Server
findings.description: A response header reveals a server or framework identifier that may help fingerprint the deployment.
findings.recommendation: Remove or minimize unnecessary version details if compatible with operational and debugging requirements.
findings.limitations: Technology identification is not itself proof of a vulnerable version or exploitable weakness.

reproduction.redirects_and_request_limits: Use the original scan configuration; this report does not store secrets or guarantee a byte-for-byte replay.
